verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB's feature-status docs list materialized views and refreshable materialized views as supported. Its ingestion docs say the Kafka table engine and materialized views work as documented. Together these give incremental insert-triggered transformations, scheduled refresh-style transformations, and stream ingestion inside the platform, and CHKit adds deploying pipelines as code. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of continuous transformation behavior on the separated storage layer (only feature-list mentions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
